about: Community rooms. Each condition group lists condition keys from data/rules/conditions.json; every key belongs to exactly one group (engine/communityMatch.test.ts checks this). People are placed in condition groups automatically once they agree; optional rooms are joined by hand. Diet and allergy matches on a condition group only add people who opted into automatic placement.

groups.title: Heart health
groups.blurb: Blood pressure, heart failure and cholesterol. Eating out with less salt and saturated fat.

groups.title: Kidney health
groups.blurb: Kidney disease and kidney stones. Potassium, phosphorus, sodium and oxalate around food.

groups.title: Diabetes
groups.blurb: Finding carbs and sugar on a menu before you order.

groups.title: Gluten-free living
groups.blurb: Celiac and gluten-free. Cross-contact, hidden wheat and places that get it right.

groups.title: Dairy-free
groups.blurb: Lactose intolerance and dairy allergy. Butter, cream and whey where you would not expect them.

groups.title: Liver health
groups.blurb: Cirrhosis and fatty liver. Salt, alcohol and sugar when eating out.

groups.title: Gut health
groups.blurb: Reflux and ulcerative colitis. Spice, fat and the dishes that sit well.

groups.title: Gout
groups.blurb: Purines, alcohol and sugary drinks on a menu.

groups.title: Plant-based
groups.blurb: Vegan and vegetarian. Spotting gelatin, fish sauce and stock.

groups.title: Nut allergy
groups.blurb: Peanuts and tree nuts. Sauces, desserts and shared fryers.

groups.title: Seafood allergy
groups.blurb: Fish, shellfish and molluscs. Stocks, sauces and dressings.
